item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With a cold front moving across the coast of Guangdong, there will still be a few showers over the region tomorrow. Temperatures will fall slightly. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coastal areas of southern China during the weekend. With the monsoon moderating gradually early next week, the weather will improve with temperatures rising over the region.
